components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single dominant action on an operational decision surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height:34px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:8px; color:var(--ag-content-on-action, #09090b); background:var(--ag-action-primary, #fafafa); box-shadow:none; font:500 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ag-action-primary-hover, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--ag-action-primary-active, #e4e4e7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ag-focus-ring, #22d3ee); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Default Action
components.description: Neutral secondary work keeps the primary decision unambiguous.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { height:34px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid var(--ag-border-default, rgba(255,255,255,.10)); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ag-content-primary, #ededef); background:var(--ag-surface-container, #111114); box-shadow:none; font:500 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background:var(--ag-surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.045)); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ag-focus-ring, #22d3ee); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Repository Search
components.description: Outlined input for searching names, coordinates, and digests.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:var(--ag-content-secondary, #a1a1aa); font:500 12.5px/18px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-width:0; height:34px; padding:4px 11px; border:1px solid var(--ag-border-default, rgba(255,255,255,.10)); border-radius:8px; color:var(--ag-content-primary, #ededef); background:var(--ag-surface-container, #111114); font:400 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ag-focus-ring, #22d3ee); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: A flat work surface with a quiet semantic boundary.
components.html:
Repository health

PostgreSQL and object storage are reachable.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--ag-border-default, rgba(255,255,255,.10)); border-radius:12px; color:var(--ag-content-primary, #ededef); background:var(--ag-surface-container, #111114); box-shadow:none; font:400 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display:block; color:var(--ag-content-strong, #fafafa); font-weight:600; } .ds-card p { margin:8px 0 0; color:var(--ag-content-secondary, #a1a1aa); }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Current location uses a neutral surface and a restrained signal edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { position:relative; display:flex; min-height:38px; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:8px; color:var(--ag-content-strong, #fafafa); background:var(--ag-surface-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.045)); font:500 14px/20px 'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-selected::before { position:absolute; top:20%; bottom:20%; left:0; width:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--ag-link, #22d3ee); content:""; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ag-focus-ring, #22d3ee); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Metric strips are compact summaries, not a replacement for the page's primary task. Values use tabular numbers and status tone only when the metric is genuinely actionable. At small widths the strip reflows without clipping or hiding labels.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width:0; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--ag-border-default, rgba(255,255,255,.10)); border-radius:12px; color:var(--ag-content-primary, #ededef); background:var(--ag-surface-container, #111114); font-family:'Geist Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans SC', sans-serif; } .ds-metric span { display:block; color:var(--ag-content-tertiary, #8b8b94); font-size:12.5px; line-height:18px; } .ds-metric strong { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--ag-content-strong, #fafafa); font-size:24px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-metric small { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--ag-content-secondary, #a1a1aa); font-size:12.5px; line-height:18px; }

narrative.overview:
Artifact Gateway Console should feel like the control surface for a system whose claims can be proved, built with the care of a well-made developer tool. The visual language is calm, precise, and generous: neutral layers separated by hairline borders, open spacing, and a single foreground-colored primary action. Real status, immutable identity, policy boundaries, and recoverable actions receive attention before decoration. The default dark theme is a quiet, near-black workspace rather than a glowing dashboard; the light theme preserves the same hierarchy instead of becoming a separate product.

The [v2 design canvas](https://claude.ai/artifact/V5Hyr915rnoPv477jcc8Xr) shows the target dashboard, repository list, repository detail, command palette, and tokens.

The interface is an **Operate** surface. Density, scanability, predictable Ant Design behavior, keyboard access, and fast state feedback outrank spectacle. Product character comes from protocol-aware objects, monospaced identities, the source-to-distribution lifecycle, and restrained signal cyan—not from gradients, oversized marketing type, or ornamental motion.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-led hierarchy: health, risk, blocked work, and required action appear before decorative metrics.
Protocol-native specificity: coordinates, digests, Repository types, and lifecycle stages remain visible and copyable.
Restrained signal color: cyan identifies links, current location, and focus only; the primary action is a solid foreground fill; semantic colors retain their status meanings.
Layered but flat surfaces: hairline borders and tonal separation establish structure; shadows are reserved for overlays.
Identity as a swatch: formats and states are a small colored mark beside neutral, readable text.
Crisp motion: short, interruptible feedback supports state change and never delays frequent navigation.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Cyan is reserved for location, focus, and trusted system links; it should not become a button fill or a general decorative fill.

rules.name: The Neutral Selection Rule
rules.body: Native text selection is a content state. Its background is derived from foreground and container neutrals, never from the primary action color.

rules.name: The Accent Budget Rule
rules.body: Generic icons, neutral badges, empty states, disabled controls, ordinary hover, card borders, and large decorative washes do not spend the primary accent. Actual identity marks are the only decorative exception.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and error colors must be paired with text, an icon, or both. Color alone never communicates operational state. A state with no data is neutral, never success.

rules.name: The Identity Is a Swatch Rule
rules.body: Artifact formats are an 8px categorical swatch beside neutral monospace text (`FormatBadge`); states are a status-colored dot beside status-colored text (`StatusText`); Hosted/Proxy is neutral monospace text (`RepositoryTypeBadge`). Colored pills are reserved for counts and filters, never for identity, so labels stay readable in every theme.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where exact character identity matters; names, explanations, statuses, and actions stay in the primary UI font.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Ten- or eleven-pixel text is reserved for non-essential marks only. Operational guidance and status metadata use the label or body role.

rules.name: The Parent Owns Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Direct page children have no external vertical margin. `ag-page-stack` and the intentional primary boundary own page spacing.

rules.name: The Geometry Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Responsive acceptance uses DOM rectangles, overflow assertions, and desktop/mobile browser screenshots—not class-name inspection alone.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Raised Rule
rules.body: Hover may adjust border or tonal background. Large shadows appear only when the component has actually moved above its context.

dos: Do preserve real API data, protocol deep links, copy commands, immutable identities, and format-specific operations when refining a surface.
Do use Ant Design components and tokens for controls, tables, overlays, messages, and semantic states before creating a custom primitive.
Do keep public, authenticated, loading, error, empty, partial-data, and disabled states explicit.
Do use `ag-page-stack`, 16px related spacing, and the intentional 24px primary boundary for page flow.
Do verify desktop, mobile, light, dark, keyboard, and reduced-motion behavior in proportion to the changed surface.
Do keep animation crisp, purposeful, and interruptible.
donts: Don't turn the Console into a generic card-and-table admin template; expose Artifact Gateway's protocol, identity, trust, and lifecycle semantics.
Don't fabricate capacity, health, scan, vulnerability, release, or availability data.
Don't use `transition-all`, animate layout properties, or replay staggered page entrances during frequent administration.
Don't use low-contrast muted text for required guidance or encode state through color alone.
Don't add page-level spacing through child margins or pairwise sibling selectors.
Don't introduce a second component, toast, or motion library when Ant Design and CSS already cover the interaction.
Don't weaken protocol, OpenAPI, deep-link, browser, upgrade, or recovery gates to make a visual change pass.
